findings: Authority reread (as the user asked). PROJECT.md line 281 (D4 row) says 'Per-phrase timing direction on the real take is withheld until calibration'. In docs/agent-notes/2026-10-05-user-prompts.md, line 29 asks to 'identify / mark rhythm issues', line 39 asks where the musician 'rushed / miuseed beats', and line 49 gives the metronome as 'around 178bpm'. The spec header (TIMING_CALIBRATION_S3.md lines 7-22) cites exactly these, and the lane makes no real-take claim.

Scope (check 1) passes. Diff from merge-base 452fd46 to HEAD d305f54 touches 13 files, all in the owned list: scripts/timing_calibration.py, tests/test_timing_calibration.py, the spec, the research note, the SKILL.md draft, program/tool-drafts/timing_calibration.json and 7 receipts named docs/agent-notes/sprints/20261007-s3/timing_calibration-*.json. There are no root-owned or foreign edits.

Forbidden writes (check 2) pass. program/tools.json, scripts/tool_api.py and just/workflow.just are not in the diff. Generated output sits only under the gitignored worktree directory artifacts/s2/timing_calibration/ (dev/, sealed/, logs). command_analyze and command_apply refuse output under artifacts/runs (timing_calibration.py lines 1468-1469 and 1501-1502). There are no download, socket or thread calls, no daemons, and the only subprocess use is rhythm.run with a timeout.

Test rerun (check 4) matches the lane's claim. I ran FFMPEG/FFPROBE=nix ffmpeg-headless-8.1.2 with PYTHONPATH=tests python3 -m unittest test_timing_calibration -v in the worktree: 'Ran 26 tests in 42.315s, OK (skipped=2)'. That is 26 run, 24 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, 2 skipped (the env-gated SealedEvaluationTests and SealedEvaluationR2Tests).

The sealing chronology holds. The eval.json hashes (timing_calibration.py 58d7440b..., the tests 8ec64dd4..., the spec ef1fd042...) match commit 9918aee. The eval-r2.json hashes (2a93a165..., 789bab63..., 1ccad935...) match 339ae09 and are unchanged at HEAD. rhythm.py (cd719914...) and phrase_timing.py (0d3c248b...) are identical at every lane commit. Commit times run: R1 preregistration 11:46:09, run started 15:46:20Z; R2 preregistration 12:03:47, run started 16:04:04Z. The gitignored sealed/results.json and results-r2.json sha256 values (de04b64a..., 7b433332...) match the receipts. Spec sections 5 and 7 were not edited after the seal; only section 11 was appended.

Numbers I reproduced (check 6) from the per-case data in the results receipts. R2: E1 median |error| 0.9777 ms over 48 (withheld counted as infinite), coverage 41/41; E2 1.1769 ms, 41/41; sign-correct 31+31 = 62/62; E1 emission on |δ| ≥ 15 ms 20/21; on-time emissions 0/24; E3 measured-only median 4.752 ms, coverage 16/38, 1/27 wrong sign. R1: E1 calibrated 4/8, measured-only median 1.081 ms, coverage 17/18, 34/34 sign-correct. Constants: c(21 °C) = 331.3·√(1 + 21/273.15) = 343.8 m/s, or 2.909 ms/m; 1.858 = 2·1.253/1.349; seed 5601 path delay 0.375 ms = 6 samples at 16 kHz. All match the receipts.

Claim classes (check 3) are correct. All results are labelled M-syn with denominators. listening = [], real_take_processed = false, default_adoption = false. FIXED_UNKNOWNS (lines 134-144) carry human_intent_is_ground_truth = false, filters_applied = [] and audio_written = false. Directions are framed as listening hypotheses, never grades. The tool draft's evidence_kind is 'synthetic_validated..._real_take_unvalidated'. I found no missed-note or note-correctness verdicts.

Doctrine (check 5) passes. There is no high-pass, notch or filter. T4 checks 32.70 Hz power is more than 4× the 47 Hz control and that the samples' sha256 is unchanged (tests lines 157-171). Timeouts are bounded: probe 30 s, decode 180 s (rhythm.run default), analyze 600 s via SIGALRM (lines 1549-1551), sealed run 1800 s. JSON is capped at 64 MiB, audio at 600 s, and symlink, URL and traversal inputs are refused (lines 1415-1425).

Test gap: test_on_click_segment_never_sets_the_offset (tests lines 260-270) never asserts that the shifted record's offset_correction_ms.estimate equals the unshifted one. It only checks that the consistency median changed. The property does hold in the code, because the offset is formed (lines 874-886) before on_click is read (line 888). Add assertEqual(shifted['offset_correction_ms']['estimate'], record['offset_correction_ms']['estimate']).

Stale test counts in two receipts. timing_calibration-handoff.json validation and timing_calibration-implementation.json post_eval_fix.dev_tests_after_fix both say 'Ran 25 tests OK (skipped=1)'. The test file at 339ae09 and HEAD (sha 789bab63) has 26 tests with 2 skips, which my rerun confirms.

The on-time emission denominators are partly vacuous. In R1, 0/24 includes 14 on-time phrases in abstained cases, where no direction can be emitted; only 10 were in calibrated cases. In R2, 10 of the 24 on-time phrases were withheld by the click-coincidence guard, so the direction rule produced 0 emissions on 14. The research note table (lines 211-214) shows 0/24 without this context.

Provenance wording. The implementation summary says the isolation finding came from 'dev seeds 11–21 (before the first sealed run)', but seeds 14-21 were used only after R1 (spec section 11); section 10 says 11-13. Spec section 11 also says the R2 fix was 'developed on dev seeds 11–21 only', while eval-results.json failure_diagnosis_after_seal records a read-only diagnostic rerun on sealed seeds 5501, 5503, 5504 and 5508. Section 7.5 permits this because R2 used fresh seeds, but section 11 should say so.
A1(c) is loose: the fan-masked test accepts either click_grid_not_fitted or insufficient_click_events (tests line 241), not one expected reason as the contract implies.

T2 is mildly circular: its 'truth' bias uses the estimator's own valid-row selection, nearest to a true onset (tests lines 148-150), not an independent isolated-event set as spec section 5 defines it.

Error typing. A failure in rhythm.probe (no audio stream, ffprobe error or bad duration) at line 1474 runs outside the decode try/except. It surfaces as a generic exit 1, not the typed decode_failed abstained record or an input_invalid refusal.

FIXED_UNKNOWNS hardcodes real_take_direction = 'not_claimed_by_lane' (line 144), and validate_record enforces it on every record and view. After root admits the tool, a future operator calibration record would still carry this lane-scoped wording. Root should consider renaming it at admission.

R2 observation, disclosed by the lane: seed 5605 had a +20 ms truth phrase measured near +5 ms and left within_uncertainty, which is the same click and attack confound as the guard. Together with the real take's 74/216 click-coincident onsets, the guard may withhold many real-take phrases. That is expected conservative behaviour, not a defect.
